name: Unpack
summary: Installs anything on Linux in one drop: `.deb`, `.rpm`, AppImage, Flatpak, Snap, scripts, archives and git URLs. Detects the distro, shows the plan, then installs, tracks and uninstalls. Rust and Tauri.

name: Monolith
summary: Single-container backend suite in Rust: multi-app SQLite, compiled access rules, auth, realtime, sync and an embedded admin UI.

name: RideLink
summary: Open-source TVS Connect alternative for the TVS Ntorq 125. Turn-by-turn arrows on the scooter display, caller ID and ride analytics, with no account and no cloud.

name: Parley
summary: Lightweight multi-account WhatsApp desktop app for Linux, built with Go and Wails instead of Electron.

name: CodeDock
summary: Self-hosted Codespaces alternative that provisions code-server containers through the Docker SDK. Written in Go.

name: CodePilot
summary: Local-first CI/CD dashboard that runs GitHub Actions with `nektos/act`.

name: Roadlyn
summary: AI roadmap SaaS. LangChain and the Vercel AI SDK on Fastify, with BullMQ jobs.

name: BIT App
summary: Campus app for BIT Mesra. Used by 1,000+ students, rated 4.7/5 on Google Play.

name: TTS-Engine
summary: Android text-to-speech library published on JitPack, 500+ downloads.
